== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Death Mark & •Hutt Bounty (Errata)]] (<code>1281_10</code>, Virtual Block 8.1 slip 05), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-05-Death_Mark_Hutt_Bounty.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-deathmarkandhuttbounty-pre.gif]]) show the original text of [[Death Mark & •Hutt Bounty]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive). The Virtual Master list and the 21 July 2012 VBlock8Type capture spell “cancelled”; this image follows the later VBlock8Type spelling “canceled”. The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Typos and capitals kept as published (“If on the Hunt on Table”).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If on the Hunt on Table, deploy on a 'mark' (opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site). Target an assassin at another site. During any move phase, when reached by target, draw destiny and add target's power; opponent draws two destiny (choosing one) and adds 'mark's defense value. If your total is higher, the 'mark' is 'assassinated': opponent loses 2 Force (4 if a Jedi), the 'mark' is lost, and relocate Death Mark to your side of table. Otherwise, place Death Mark (and may place assassin it targets) in Used Pile. May not be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1281_10</code>: frame without a lore box as printed, picture cropped from the Players Committee card image, title, Virtual Block 8 set mark, slip number 8, original-title strip, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
